contentHtml:
In recent years, AI or artificial intelligence have made rapid advancements in the digital world. From optimizing chatbots to understanding the human sense, AI definitely has a point to prove. Even the likes of Elon Musk have showcased a lot of trust and confidence in the power of AI. 

Chat GPT (Generative pre-trained transformer) is a chatbot developed by Open AI, which is basically a chatbot that provides accurate solutions to a given query. For example, if you are looking for some of the best holiday destinations in the USA, you will get human-style recommendations on chat GPT when compared to Google, where you will get a list of places to travel within the USA. 

You can find the difference between Google and Chat GPT below.

When you search about top holiday destinations in the USA on chat GPT, you will find various blogs where you can see 30+ holiday destinations in the USA, whereas when you search on chat GPT you will find an accurate solution for your query. 

So, a lot of people have flooded social media platforms saying that “Chat GPT will kill Google.” 

Is that really true? You will soon find out as we will be going to keep up some facts that will amaze your brain. In the end, we will also let you know whether chat GPT really has the potential to kick-out Google. 

Chat GPT: In a Nutshell

By now, you must have got to know about Chat GPT if you are not living in a Cave. As mentioned above, Chat GPT is a bot that is set up with the help of a wide range of data sets to ensure and provides a reply for a search query in a human conversational way. 

One of the prominent reasons why Chat GPT got more hype is it generated over 1 million users within the first five days of its launch, which is far ahead of top brands like Netflix and Instagram, which took around 5 & 2.5 months to reach the same number. 

There are also various other tasks which Chat GPT can complete, which include language translation and conversation like a chatbot. Surprisingly, you can also code with the help of chatbot conversation. Most importantly, the chat GPT is free; you can even use it and rate your experience. 

Here are some of the best advantages of chat GPT

  • Conversational style: One of the best advantages of using Chat GPT over Google is you get a more conversational style of search results when compared to Google.
  • Maintaining context: When you search about a specific topic over Google, you will need to find the right query to find the right solution, whereas, on the other hand, you will get a solution directly for your problem on chat GPT. 
  • Engaging conversations: Apart from providing human-style replies, you will also get a response for your replies and follow-ups from the chat GPT, which immensely makes it an amazing platform compared to Google. 
  • Malicious purposes: Many experts believe that chat GPTs’ open concept can also increase the chances of malicious attempts on the platform, but the platform has installed various filters to remove malicious responses and unwanted threats on the platform and combat misuse effectively. 

Now that you know what it is Chat GPT here are some of the use cases of the chat GPT

Uses Cases of Chat GPT

Customer service

One of the most prominent applications of GPT is in customer service because of its human style of response. It can also provide a good & quick response to all the customers and can also follow up on necessary queries. 

Online Education

Chat GPT has an amazing skill for explaining complicated processes in a simple way, making it an exciting platform for students to learn new topics and expand their knowledge. 

Virtual assistance

AI in virtual assistance is not something new to the digital world, and the presence of Chat GPT can make things even easier for all the people who are seeking virtual assistance for complicated tasks. 

Story writing

Final Verdict

Well, there is no doubt that Chat GPT is an exciting addition to the digital world. It has some of the top features that can challenge the majority of applications in the market.

At the same time, if you feel that it can kill Google? Then it is too early to decide whether Chat GPT can actually impact Google or its products.
